sources.entry: CleanShot X - Discover a superior way to capture your Mac's screen.

summary.name: CleanShot X
summary.one_liner: A macOS-only screenshot, screen recording, and sharing app that captures, edits, OCRs, and uploads captures from the Mac menu bar.
use_cases: capture and share a screenshot with a link
record a tutorial or demo with webcam and zooms
export screen recording as MP4 or GIF
copy text from an image or scanned document
keep reference screenshots pinned on screen
collect feedback on screenshots with a team
summary.what_it_does: CleanShot X captures screenshots and screen recordings on macOS and lets users copy, save, or drag captures into other apps. Screen recordings can include a webcam bubble, automatic click highlights, on-screen keystroke display, microphone and system audio, and automatically generated smooth zooms, and can be exported as MP4 or GIF. A built-in Mac-native video editor allows trimming and zooms, and on-device text recognition copies text and reads QR codes from images. Captures can be uploaded to CleanShot Cloud for a one-click shareable link, with comments on captures, and a capture history for finding and restoring past captures.
notable: On-device text recognition (OCR) and QR code reading built in
Automatic smooth zooms and click highlights for screen recordings
CleanShot Cloud sharing with comments and optional SSO/SCIM for teams
Pin screenshots above other windows and searchable capture history
caveats: Designed exclusively for macOS; no Windows or Linux version
Pricing is not stated on the page; team features such as SSO, SCIM and admin controls are described as add-ons for when teams need them
